metadata.description: AI VC skills: exact startup equity math and venture-style reviews for AI agents.

plugins.name: ai-vc-skills
plugins.description: Startup equity math done exactly: Paul Graham's equity equation, option pools, SAFEs and notes converting in a priced round, dilution, vesting, exit waterfalls, a founder's check of their own raise before a VC sees it, runway on a phased plan, traction metrics and a market size built bottom-up, with every formula and source shown; plus founder-side reviews of the deck, messaging, claims, partner meeting, product decisions, round size, term sheet, diligence, metrics, market size, the champion's memo and investor updates, each with an adversarial review.
